meta.title: Fix net server noDelay handling
meta.body_summary: Add Node.js test for server noDelay and call Socket.setNoDelay() when server noDelay is enabled to fix missing TCP_NODELAY handling.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added server noDelay call but new Node.js test fails on all platforms; maintainer closed citing reliance on internal .onconnection API.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 37 changed lines across 2 files (4 lines in net.ts, 33 lines test), this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step fix but was closed due to functional failure in the added test.

review_details.concern_detail: The added test test-net-server-nodelay.js still fails on all CI platforms; maintainer nektro commented that the fix does not fix the test and the test relies on potentially internal `.onconnection` API of native handle.
review_details.performance_claim: Enabling noDelay on server sockets disables Nagle's algorithm, reducing latency for small writes.
review_details.rejection_signals: Change does not fix test; relies on internal .onconnection API; closed without merge after CI failures on all platforms.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent attempted to add noDelay handling by calling setNoDelay on socket, but the Node.js test requires using an internal `.onconnection` API native handle; the fix does not resolve the test failure, indicating the agent failed to grasp internal API requirements.

detection_detail.code_reading: nektro reviewed the test and fix, concluding that the change does not fix the test and the test relies on internal .onconnection API.
detection_detail.ci_auto: robobun reported 3 categories of failures across all CI platforms, specifically the new test-net-server-nodelay.js failing with code 1 everywhere.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The added Node.js test fails on all CI platforms, providing clear evidence that the fix is insufficient.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CI failures and maintainer code review, the PR was closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: Add a new Node.js test test-net-server-nodelay.js that verifies server noDelay option works, and modify src/js/node/net.ts to call Socket.setNoDelay() when server noDelay is enabled.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The test file is newly added for verification but fails across all platforms.
change_trajectory: Commit f5264cea: Added test-net-server-nodelay.js test file and updated net.ts to call setNoDelay() on socket when server noDelay option is true.
